s2.ptxt: Engage the camshaft timing gear assembly with its key groove offset from the straight pin of the camshaft as shown in the illustration.

While lightly pushing the camshaft timing gear assembly, turn it in the direction of the arrow shown in the illustration (counterclockwise), and push it in further where the key groove aligns with the straight pin.

atten3.ptxt: Never turn the camshaft timing gear in the retard direction (clockwise).

s2.ptxt: Check that there is no clearance between the camshaft timing gear assembly and the flange of the camshaft.
Tighten the flange bolt while being careful not to let the camshaft timing gear rotate.

item.ptxt: Do not overtighten the vise and damage the camshaft.
Do not fix the camshaft timing gear assembly in place when tightening the bolt.
If it is locked at the most retarded position, release the lock pin in the camshaft timing gear before tightening the bolt.
If the bolt is tightened while it is locked, the lock pin may be damaged.

s2.ptxt: After tightening, turn the camshaft timing gear assembly in the retard direction (clockwise) to check that it moves, and check that the camshaft timing gear assembly locks at the end of its movement.
Install the camshaft so that the paint mark applied to the chain plate aligns with the timing mark of the camshaft timing gear assembly.
Check the front marks and numbers on the camshaft bearing caps, and tighten them in the order shown in the illustration.
Install the camshaft timing gear so that the paint mark applied to the chain plate aligns with the timing mark of the camshaft timing gear.
In the above condition, temporarily install camshaft No.2 to the camshaft timing gear with the set bolt.
Check the front marks and numbers on the camshaft bearing caps, and tighten them in the order shown in the illustration.
Using an adjustable wrench and union nut wrench (14mm), hold the service hexagon of the camshaft and tighten the set bolt of the camshaft timing gear.

item.ptxt: The above torque value is for when SST is not used. Calculate the torque wrench reading using the formula according to the lengths of the SST and torque wrench.
Set the adjustable wrench in a position where it does not contact the valve lifters.

s2.ptxt: After installing the chain, check that each timing mark is at the position shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: The number of chain links between the matchmarks of the camshaft timing gears is 7 links.

s2.ptxt: Release the cam lock, push in the plunger and set the hook.
Install chain tensioner assembly No.1 with a new gasket and the 2 nuts.

atten2.ptxt: If the hook is released during insertion, set it again and insert chain tensioner assembly No.1.

s2.ptxt: After installing the tensioner, turn the crankshaft slightly in reverse to release the hook of chain tensioner assembly No.1.
Turn the crankshaft in the normal direction to push out the plunger of chain tensioner assembly No.1.

atten4.ptxt: A "clicking sound" is heard when the plunger of chain tensioner assembly No.1 is pushed out.

s2.ptxt: Connect the harness clamp with the 2 clamps.
Apply Seal Packing Black at the locations shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Install within 3 minutes after applying seal packing.
Tighten the installation bolts and nuts within 15 minutes after installing the cylinder head cover.
After installation, leave it without starting the engine for 2 hours.

s2.ptxt: Install the cylinder head cover with the 8 bolts and 2 nuts.
Install the wire harness to the head cover with the 2 bolts.
Connect the ventilation hose and ventilation hose No.2.
Install the ASSY4 ignition coils with the 4 bolts.
Connect the connector.

s-1.ptxt: Install Engine Under Cover Rear RH

s2.ptxt: Install the engine under cover rear RH with the 5 clips.
Install the engine cover assembly No.1 with the 2 nuts.
Install the radiator upper air deflector with the 8 clips.
